intro: The most affordable country in the EU: prices are lower than in neighbouring Balkan states, with a clear path to a residence permit via business or real estate. A full member of the Schengen area since 2024.
climate: Continental-Mediterranean: hot summers around +28°C, moderately cold winters with precipitation. Milder along the coast.
mentality: A calm, unhurried pace. Strong family values, hospitality towards Slavic peoples, and a basic understanding of Russian among the older generation.
language_note: Bulgarian is the official language and is intuitively understood by Russian speakers. English is used in the IT and tourism sectors.
visa_note: Since 2024 a Schengen visa or residence permit is required. For Russian citizens — through the embassy, taking 1-3 months. Residence permit via business or the purchase of real estate.
